title: The Hard problem may be solved by bridging principles, not dissolved

statements.text: A Hard problem of generative models in machine learning would be solved by deeper technical understanding. The Hard problem of consciousness may be similar: neither reduced to easy problems nor dissolved, but solved through bridging principles that FEP-AI makes available by integrating theories of consciousness.

sources.quote: it may be the case of this most challenging and profound problem actually being solved through the discovery of sufficiently powerful bridging principles
